rule.ranking: TAug macro-F1 of the RF classifier, mean over seeds

flags.title: macro-F1 near 1.00, B0 included
flags.rule: B0-rf macro-F1 >= 0.95: leakage / artefact, go back to Phase 5

flags.title: TSTR above TRTR
flags.rule: TSTR minus B0 has an effect (interval excludes 0 and abs(delta) > seed std) in favour of TSTR: suspect label leakage through the synthetic data or a misused test set
flags.status: TRIGGERED, investigated: not above the class-balanced real reference
notes: TSTR trains on 5000 synthetic rows per class (balanced by construction); B0 trains on the imbalanced real train pool (quota per class: NORMAL 60000, BCF 20000, DELAYED 3000, SYN 3000, INVALID 1500, WILL 1000).

flags.title: model copies training data
flags.rule: duplicate rate > 0.01 or DCR ratio < 0.5 in any generator and seed

flags.title: large spread between seeds
flags.rule: std of macro-F1 over seeds > 0.05 for any configuration
flags.status: TRIGGERED (only in rows outside the spec matrix) - more seeds or a stability check
notes: 19 of 85 configurations are above the softer level seed_std_max = 0.02 (a note, not a red flag).

flags.title: reported epsilon far from an independent recomputation
flags.rule: relative difference above 0.1 (either sign) between the reported epsilon and the one recomputed with own RDP code, or step counters that match neither the plan nor the loader
notes: 7 runs have fewer counted DP steps than rounds x epochs x ceil(n/B) for one client: Opacus' Poisson loader has int(1 / sample_rate) batches per epoch and 1 / (1 / 99) = 98.99999999999999 truncates to 98. The report uses the counted steps (and the true sampling rate), so epsilon is right; only the noise calibration was one step per epoch more conservative than needed for that client.
